issue.title: Records cabinet head reads "Records · Records" when the stored [!records] head is bare

task_type_fields.impact: Low: a redundant cabinet header on albums whose stored Records index has a bare head. Rows, absorption, and fail-open are unaffected.
task_type_fields.repro:
Root cause: `cabinetRecordsSummaryFor` in bob-plugins
`plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/241tb-plugin-cabinet-records.js:192-199` builds the Records
cabinet summary from the stored `> [!records]` head title plus an optional
` · by <field>` grouping suffix. When the head is bare (`> [!records]` with no tally) and
the album has no `group_field`, the summary falls back to the literal `"Records"`
(`summary || "Records"` at line 199, and again at line 507). The chrome
(`240wk-plugin-cabinet-chrome.js:107-118`) renders `noun · summary`, so the header reads
"Records · Records".

Repro: an album note whose `## Records` callout head is a bare `> [!records]`. The
cabinets runner fixture uses one, so every album capture would show it if the card head
were in frame (see the companion runner-fidelity task). One live album has a bare head.
bob's own index writer (`src/native/albums/index.rs`) always emits a tally head, so the
case is an unsynced or hand-written index.

Fix options (proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.4 note #1): omit the summary when it would only
repeat the noun, or show a record count derived from the region or the album report.
Add a `scripts/test-ledger-tools-cabinets-records.cjs` case for the bare head.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.4 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent: acceptance recorded GO with this cosmetic header defect left open, so it needs its own small fix.
